name: Great-West Lifeco Inc. Preferred Shares (GWO.PR.N)
summary: Great-West Lifeco Inc., a Winnipeg-based holding company founded in 1891, is owned in part by Power Financial Corporation. In Canada, the US and Europe it sells life and health coverage, retirement and investment services, asset management and reinsurance, with benefit plan and financial solutions for individuals, families, companies and other organizations.
